title: [Godot 4.6.2 .NET] Crashes every time when opening project
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot v4.6.2.stable (71f334935)
- Not reproducible in Godot v4.6.1.stable (

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 95.63 GiB memory

### Issue description

Whenever I try to open a project with Godot v4.6.2 .NET, the editor crashes to the desktop. Same happens for existing project, which were created with v4.6.1 as well as newly created projects.

Following .NET versions are currently installed (through Visual Studio Installer):
- .NET 6.0 Runtime
- .NET 7.0 Runtime
- .NET 8.0 Runtime
- .NET 9.0 Runtime
- .NET 4.8 SDK
- .NET SDK

### Steps to reproduce

Start Godot, create a new project or open an existing project. Crash occurs before the editor opens the project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Create a new project, attached a demo project.

[new-game-project-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26602041/new-game-project-2.zip)
